name: comp-305
blurb: Dark dismissible feature banner with icon, message, link, and close button.
description: Full-width dark-themed feature banner with eclipse icon, message, Learn more link, and dismissible close button. Uses useState for visibility.
use_when: You need a dismissible feature announcement that users can close permanently.
avoid_when: For non-dismissible announcements; use comp-304 instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons are aria-hidden. Component uses useState to manage visibility.
